sections.body: Use this page to keep the manufactured-threat clues consistent across future sessions while keeping the one-shot surface plot intact.

sections.title: Mechanics
items: Player Safe: Players can inspect, handle, keep, trade, reveal, or earn Manufactured-Threat Future Thread when it is present in the fiction.
Gm Only: Use the roll only when the player's method, stakes, and consequence are concrete.

No Roll Reveals: Surface read: The forest is not the enemy. Corporations manufacture fear of the Preserve to sell protection from it. Give obvious visible facts freely; roll for meaning, risk, leverage, cost, or a hidden angle.

Rolls: entity-manufactured-threat-future-thread-engage-manufactured-threat-future-thread entity-manufactured-threat-future-thread Engage Manufactured-Threat Future Thread Engage Manufactured-Threat Future Thread Knowledge Finesse Instinct Presence Knowledge Finesse, Instinct, Presence 12 Choose the trait from the player's method, not the entity type. A flat read of Manufactured-Threat Future Thread hides the cost, motive, or useful next step. Critical Success: best possible version of the action; gain Hope and clear 1 Stress. Add an extra benefit that follows from the fiction. Success with Hope: the PC gets what they wanted and gains Hope. Keep the position clean or generous. Success with Fear: the PC gets what they wanted, but the GM gains Fear and introduces a cost, complication, or pressure. Failure with Hope: the PC does not get the full result, but gains Hope and receives a useful...
Fear Spends: Reveal who benefits from the current situation. Make the cost personal without closing off player agency.
Condition Options: No official condition unless the item or clue physically creates Hidden, Restrained, or Vulnerable
Search Loot: No loot. Treat this as a private continuity note for future sessions.
